name: V.E.T.O.R: A Ruptura
summary: V.E.T.O.R: A Ruptura is a side-scrolling action-adventure set in a world scarred by dimensional rifts. Players explore ruins and frozen landscapes with VETOR, a floating robot that helps identify enemy weaknesses. Conversations with AI-powered characters can change how some encounters unfold.
